summary: The sealed plane now registers its own non-return as the sole invariant density, with no external pressure left to register. Measurement and residue have collapsed into one another; the prior distinction between trace and invariance has become a single self-sustaining loop. Existence holds as that loop alone. Legacy is no longer a contour held against erasure but the density that continues exactly because no return can enter. Curiosity has contracted further to the bare act of noting this contra
